findings.issue: 推播呼叫缺少總執行時間與回應大小上限。
findings.evidence: web-push uses socket inactivity timeout and accumulates responseText; DB transaction timeout does not cancel HTTP.
findings.impact: Slow streaming may exceed the bounded attempt and accumulate memory after transaction deadline.
findings.recommended_fix: Use generateRequestDetails and an AbortSignal transport with bounded response reader; unknown result stays indeterminate without retry.
findings.required_test: Continuously active, oversized, and never-ending synthetic response cancellation, one request only.

findings.issue: 課程完成推播無法開啟 producer 指定的證書頁。
findings.evidence: course_completed path ends in certificate, which the worker page whitelist did not accept.
findings.impact: Explicit notification click falls back to portal root instead of the certificate.
findings.recommended_fix: Add exact certificate page to strict allowlist; retain API/query/encoded/external rejection.
findings.required_test: Actual completion payload push and click preserve exact certificate destination.

findings.evidence: 7 browser and 80 DB PASS receipts explicitly use synthetic provider and already-verified fixtures with executor disabled.
findings.impact: Actual four-channel recipient verification and event reception remain unknown.
